calls: One new background-replacement edit per original JPEG. No cutout, composite or prior generated image was used as input.
render_strategy: The website displays each final opaque studio image through responsive WebP display copies sized for the actual CSS image width and device pixel ratio. No alpha mask or generated CSS backdrop layer remains. CSS alone matches zoom and eyeline, with a flat neutral-grey matte solely for necessary layout margins. Original JPEG and final studio PNG files are preserved; edited portraits are visually faithful to the JPEGs, not asserted to be pixel-identical. Retained native-resolution WebP masters and native-width variants preserve every decoded RGBA pixel of their approved studio PNGs. Smaller display copies use only mechanical Lanczos resizing and high-quality q96 WebP encoding, with no retouching, new crop or another AI edit.

delivery.encoder: Pillow WEBP lossless=True quality=100 method=6 exact=True

responsive_delivery.resizing: Lanczos, maintaining the native aspect ratio without upscaling
responsive_delivery.encoding: Resized display copies: WebP lossless=False quality=96 method=6. Native-width variants: WebP lossless=True quality=100 method=6 exact=True.
responsive_delivery.sizes: Per-portrait CSS width including the 1.25 mobile framing scale
responsive_delivery.master_reference: data-original-src retains the native-resolution lossless WebP URL

prompt_template:
Use case: precise-object-edit
Asset type: website team portrait, final direct photograph.
Input image: this ORIGINAL photograph is the sole edit target, {stem}. No previous generated image or cutout is an input.
Primary request: replace ONLY the background in this original photo with a standard neutral grey photography-studio backdrop in one edit. Use a seamless neutral grey #b7b7b7 background with a very subtle studio falloff toward #c8c8c8 near the upper center and #a5a5a5 at the far lower edges; matching all other team portraits. Opaque finished photograph.
Critical invariants: the original photographed person must remain EXACTLY unchanged. Preserve original foreground pixels/identity, exact face and expression, eyes/nose/mouth, natural skin texture, fine hair and all strands, pose, body proportions, visible arms/hands, clothing and every fabric pattern/button/logo/text/jewelry detail, original colors and lighting. Do not retouch or relight the person. Keep original canvas/aspect/framing and every originally visible person part; no zooming or recropping. Background-only replacement, not a newly generated portrait.
Avoid: face regeneration, beautification, sharpening, skin smoothing, color changes, artificial person relighting, restyling, redrawing clothing, extra body/limbs, text, watermark, props, scenery, halos or sharp foreground cutout borders.

reference_roles.Jonathan-Al-Hinn-studio.png: Framing reference only; not an identity source

editions.prompt:
Use case: lighting-weather
Asset type: existing MACH website team-lead portrait, single original-source photographic edit.
Input images: Image 1 (Jonathan-Al-Hinn.jpg) is the ONLY photographed person/edit target. Image 2 (Jonathan-Al-Hinn-studio.png) is ONLY framing/scale reference, not a source of face pixels. Images 3 (Sam), 4 (Toby), 5 (Madison) are ONLY references for soft diffuse portrait lighting and seamless neutral-grey backdrop. Do not blend any other person's identity into Jonathan.
Primary request: Starting directly from Image 1, give Jonathan the same soft balanced neutral studio light as the reference lead photos and replace only the concrete bleachers background with the matching opaque neutral grey photography backdrop. His current overhead outdoor lighting causes too-bright forehead/nose highlights and deep shadow under the eyebrows; gently soften those highlights and add subtle diffuse fill to those eye-socket/brow shadows. Preserve natural facial dimensionality and his true medium olive complexion. Match neutral white balance without making skin lighter or changing ethnicity. Backdrop #b7b7b7 with subtle upper-center #c8c8c8 falloff and lower-edge #a5a5a5, same as the other leads.
Composition: Exactly retain the original portrait's 3:4 canvas, viewpoint, visible body, head scale, position, eye line, crop, seated pose, shoulders, neckline, hands outside frame. Match the existing Jonathan studio composition in image 2. No zoom, recrop, pose change, extra canvas, new limbs, or furniture. One finished photograph of Jonathan alone.
Critical identity invariants: retain his exact original facial structure, eyes, eyebrows, nose, mouth, beard, all curly hair and wisps, age, relaxed closed-mouth expression and gaze, natural pores and small imperfections. Retain every original detail and texture of the charcoal-black diamond-pattern knit polo, white piping, collar and black buttons. Only exposure/light balance and background may change. No beautification, smoothing, face reconstruction, slimming, reshaping, new catchlights, sharpening or artificial skin-lightening. No extra people, text, watermark, logos, accessories, halos or dramatic rim lighting. Photorealistic, understated, faithful photography correction, not a newly imagined portrait.
editions.review: Original, previous studio image, edited candidate and reference leads independently visually reviewed before integration. Softer forehead highlights and diffuse brow/eye fill preserve recognizable identity, natural complexion, original pose/clothing/framing. Original JPEG, previous studio PNG/WebP and all other lead assets retained unchanged.
editions.pixel_verification: Native delivery and retained new PNG compare equal in every decoded RGBA pixel. Image editing itself is not claimed pixel-identical to the original photograph.
